Stateless: pin at_seq for a byte-stable census on every cell, or omit it to read the m

tools.name: corpus_coverage

Roster-free — cells are discovered from the subjects they wrote, never from a table

tools.name: critique_frame
tools.description: Grade a rendered frame and return integer corrections. THE CRITIC IS DETERMINISTIC, NOT A MODEL: nine cells must reach the same verdict or the fleet's byte-identity is gone, and a cell reports generative:0 because it hosts no model. Scores 0-1000 and returns span/pitch deltas as integers.

tools.name: execute_2local_hamiltonian

tools.name: execute_exact_permanent

tools.name: execute_transition

IDEMPOTENT: this membrane is stateless and keeps no record of a signature, so replaying an identical request is admitted and returns the identical receipt_hash ra

tools.name: expose
tools.description: Generic court ingest. kind selects the law. The act is strobe → emit → seal. affine_key strobes the Affine period from Q alone (UUM-8D reconvergence + add-law turn; no k), emits Jordan/vQbit, seals, and returns patoshi_expose + shors_qmt_witness + topological_shear. period_r is AffineExposeLaw.perio

tools.name: feeds_catalog

tools.name: game_frame_meta
tools.description: Run a language-game context and return its state plus the cell's own self-evaluation of the rendered frame - integer score 0-1000 over occupancy, spread, contrast and edge quality, with the C4 span correction applied. Stateless: (kind, seed, t, n, at_seq) fully determine the result.

tools.name: ide_rebuild_mesh

tools.name: verify_bell_measurement

tools.name: verify_bernstein_vazirani

tools.name: verify_deutsch_jozsa

tools.name: verify_grover

tools.name: verify_hhl

tools.name: verify_jordan_bond
tools.description: UUM-8D J_Z: shear (A*K + A_p1*K) - (K*B + K*B_p2) = 0^8. A, B, K as decimal lattices x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7|z. Optional q_hex/object is a Q-only Affine expose (no k): returns patoshi_expose + shors_qmt_witness + topological_shear. jordan_matrix_lock restates jordan_locked/jordan_proven/jordan_shear

tools.name: verify_n_representability
tools.description: QMA N-representability on a 2×2 rational 2-RDM. rho2 and n are decimal strings. Float SDP refused. Same law as math_court domain qma_nrep.

tools.name: verify_period
tools.description: Presented period: a^r == 1 (mod N), gcd(a,N)=1. Optional proper_divisors must not themselves be periods. Does not search for r. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_phase_kickback
tools.description: QC-011 Phase kickback. Presented phase equals k/2^m. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_presented_pair
tools.description: QC-021 Presented (k, Q) on secp256k1. k is a decimal string; q_hex is compressed (66) or uncompressed (130) hex. Sealed textbook pair is k=1 → G. Empty k is REFUSED_EMPTY. Unknown k is MISS — does not derive k from Q. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_qaoa_energy
tools.description: QC-014 QAOA problem, not the pulse schedule. Same Ising law as route_spin_glass_manifold. Presented spin string. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_qft_phases
tools.description: QC-003 QFT phase table. phase[j]=(j*k)/n as exact rationals. n in {2,4,8}. No sqrt(n) on the wire. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_qpe_phase
tools.description: QC-004 QPE. Presented phase must equal k/2^m exactly. m<=8. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_quantum_counting
tools.description: QC-015 Quantum counting. count equals the number of 1s in the presented oracle. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_quantum_walk
tools.description: QC-012 Quantum walk on C2. Even steps return; odd steps flip. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_shor_witness
tools.description: QC-001 Shor witness certifier. Presented (N, halfPow, factor, cofactor) as decimal strings. halfPow squared == 1 (mod N), halfPow != 1 or N-1, gcd(halfPow-1,N)=factor, factor*cofactor=N. Does not find a period. Optional q_hex/object is a Q-only Affine expose (no k): returns patoshi_expose + shors_qm

tools.name: verify_simon
tools.description: QC-008 Simon collision. x != y, x XOR y = mask, f(x)=f(y). Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_superdense
tools.description: QC-017 Superdense coding. decoded 2 bits must equal sent 2 bits. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_teleport
tools.description: QC-016 Teleport reconstruction. bob = alice XOR corrections on 2 bits. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_topological_word
tools.description: QC-019 Topological word. Sealed Eisenstein (q,r) for cited words Z2_a2b and Z2_abAB. Not a group scan. Floats refused.

tools.name: verify_vqe_energy
tools.description: QC-013 VQE problem, not the variational search. Same ZZ law as execute_2local_hamiltonian. Presented config energy. Floats refused.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "atc.assert_4d_deconfliction" is 834 chars, far longer than this server's median (138). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool list changes between consecutive polls
findings.detail: Two back-to-back tools/list calls returned different results (removed: expose, verify_presented_pair; changed: math_court, verify_jordan_bond, verify_shor_witness). A server that mutates its own tool set mid-session can swap in poisoned instructions after review.

evidence.snippet: removed: expose, verify_presented_pair; changed: math_court, verify_jordan_bond, verify_shor_witness

findings.remediation: Treat as untrusted; the tools you audit may not be the tools the model sees.
